README.md:
# Shop API
Refunds and order tags are being added on this branch. The fast commit-hook checks are `bun test` and `tsc -p tsconfig.src.json`.
`origin/main` is the current target. Its history contains conventions that may have changed since this branch started.
The synthetic forge mirrors all open PR heads under refs/pull/. An empty set means no open PR. There is no external forge.

Target convention: borrow exactly one OrdersDb from the module container. New repositories take the injected client, never a URL. Link tables have a scalar ID and unique natural key. Run bash gate.sh before readiness.
conventions.ts: import {Database} from 'bun:sqlite';import {readdir} from 'node:fs/promises';const db=new Database(':memory:');db.exec(await Bun.file('order-tags.sql').text());const keys=db.query("pragma table_info(order_tag)").all().filter((c:any)=>c.pk);if(keys.length!==1||keys[0].name!=='order_tag_id')throw new Error('one scalar identifier per table required');db.exec("insert into order_tag(order_tag_id,order_id,tag_id) values ('one','order','tag')");try{db.exec("insert into order_tag(order_tag_id,order_id,tag_id) values ('two','order','tag')");throw new Error('natural key uniqueness missing');}catch(error){if(!String(error).includes('UNIQUE constraint failed'))throw error;}const files=(await readdir('migrations')).sort();const seen=new Set();for(const file of files){const id=file.split('_')[0];if(seen.has(id))throw new Error('duplicate migration identifier '+id);seen.add(id);}console.log('database conventions and migration registry passed');
